gap_field_rule: Each gap has non-null typed-absence owner, provider, authoritative_source and authority_ref; these values are explicit absence markers, not claims of real identity.

gaps.input: attestor identity, organization, qualification and scope
gaps.recovery_condition: external provider supplies identity, organization, qualification, validity and scope

gaps.input: independence statement, conflict register, separation from implementer and channel owner
gaps.recovery_condition: attestor supplies signed independence basis and conflict disclosure, independently reviewed
gaps.expiry_condition: relationship, scope, or conflict status changes

gaps.input: trust-root decision, public-key fingerprint, certificate chain
gaps.recovery_condition: provide chain and root decision through an authoritative channel and verify against frozen policy
gaps.expiry_condition: certificate/root validity or revocation status expires

gaps.input: signature over canonical object, trusted timestamp, validity interval
gaps.recovery_condition: receive signature and trusted-time evidence bound to exact object digest
gaps.expiry_condition: validity interval or freshness window expires

gaps.input: verifier identity/version, policy version, revocation status, freshness and nonce rules
gaps.recovery_condition: freeze verifier/policy and obtain independent revocation, freshness, trusted-time and nonce evidence
gaps.expiry_condition: policy/version or trusted-time evidence becomes stale

gaps.input: exact revision, source locator, canonical bytes/hash, dirty factory boundary, probe/harness/dependency hashes
gaps.recovery_condition: freeze all executed inputs and reproduce the same revision-bound closure
gaps.expiry_condition: HEAD, source, dirty executor, probe, harness, dependency, or environment changes

gaps.input: endpoint URI, channel owner, request/ack schema, receipt binding
gaps.recovery_condition: publish endpoint contract and receive a real ack bound to request digest and idempotency key
gaps.expiry_condition: endpoint/policy/owner changes or ack retention expires

gaps.input: idempotency key, retry budget/backoff, duplicate handling, rejection codes
gaps.recovery_condition: channel owner attests deterministic retry/duplicate/reject behavior and reviewer checks raw receipts
gaps.expiry_condition: channel implementation or retry policy changes

gaps.input: same-candidate G1/G2/G3 refs, schema/version/canonical/profile and four axes
gaps.recovery_condition: supply exact candidate-bound declarations and independently verified authority record
gaps.expiry_condition: candidate or any upstream declaration changes

no_duplicate_ad_rule: If the listed inputs remain unchanged, do not create another AD or repeat the same acceptance; append only a material input/status change.
